seasons.plot: Four year ten students-Jake, Felix, Andy and Sam-are grouped together during a school orienteering excursion at the Bremin Ranges National Park and get lost. After getting caught in an unexpected storm, the boys spend the night in the forest. When they return home the next morning, the boys get chased by a furious tornado and discover that some strange things have happened; Felix's disabled brother Oscar can walk, Andy's sister Viv owns his room, and Jake cannot get into his house.

seasons.plot:
The Nowhere Boys have found their way home, but Felix, Jake, Sam and Andy soon discover the adventure doesn't stop just because they're back.

As they experiment with their new and unpredictable powers over earth, wind, fire and water, the boys realise they aren't the only ones who crossed back to this universe.

episodes.plot: Felix, Andy, Jake and Sam have returned home, but still the universe seems out of balance. Felix is concerned that Alice has followed them back and Andy hopes his new power will get Ellen to notice him.

episodes.name: The New Boy
episodes.plot: When people start to vanish on Luke's first day at school, he finds himself thrown together with an unlikely group of friends - the new Nowhere Boys. They must figure out how to save the town from becoming an empty wasteland.

episodes.name: What Happened To Bremin?
episodes.plot: The Nowhere Boys comb the streets of Bremin for signs of life but find themselves under attack from a mysterious life force.

episodes.name: We Are Not Alone
episodes.plot: The gang catch their mysterious stalker, who is just as confused by this strange and empty world, as they are.

episodes.name: The Gang Find Magic
episodes.plot: The gang learn they can do magic & plan to cast a dimensional return spell, which requires sacrificing their heart's desire. They search for Brooklyn but are attacked by a monster, which they fend off using magic.

translations.value: The gang learn they can do magic & plan to cast a dimensional return spell, which requires sacrificing their heart's desire. They search for Brooklyn but are attacked by a monster, which they fend off using magic.

episodes.name: Bates To The Rescue
episodes.plot: An unhinged Principal Bates is trying to make everything normal by pretending it is normal. He locks the gang in a classroom, but they finally escape and cast the dimensional return spell - will they get home?

translations.value: An unhinged Principal Bates is trying to make everything normal by pretending it is normal. He locks the gang in a classroom, but they finally escape and cast the dimensional return spell - will they get home?

episodes.name: Are We Home Yet?
episodes.plot: The gang are home & everything is perfect, life couldn't be better, except for Nicco who questions if this really is their Bremin. Discovering they're actually suspended in a dream state the gang manage to wake themselves up.

translations.value: The gang are home & everything is perfect, life couldn't be better, except for Nicco who questions if this really is their Bremin. Discovering they're actually suspended in a dream state the gang manage to wake themselves up.

episodes.name: The Trouble With Ben
episodes.plot: The gang are definitely back home, but unbeknownst to them there are two Ben's [sic]! One good and one bad - will the gang learn the truth before Bad Ben sends them back to the Empty World?

translations.value: The gang are definitely back home, but unbeknownst to them there are two Ben's [sic]! One good and one bad - will the gang learn the truth before Bad Ben sends them back to the Empty World?

episodes.name: Back To The Empty World
episodes.plot: Ben 1 & Ben 2 are stranded in the empty world, & despite our gang successfully bringing them home; Ben 1 still wants to get rid of them. Ben 2 immobilises Ben 1.

translations.value: Ben 1 & Ben 2 are stranded in the empty world, & despite our gang successfully bringing them home; Ben 1 still wants to get rid of them. Ben 2 immobilises Ben 1.

episodes.name: The Truth Spell
episodes.plot: The gang perform a truth spell on Ben 2 to ensure they can always tell the two Bens apart, but the spell backfires when Heath mixes up the words and our gang all have to tell the truth

translations.value: The gang perform a truth spell on Ben 2 to ensure they can always tell the two Bens apart, but the spell backfires when Heath mixes up the words and our gang all have to tell the truth

episodes.name: Unwanted Visitors
episodes.plot: The Mini Demons come to Bremin High and cause havoc. Our gang catch them and keep them in their school bags, but they exert a negative influence over the gang - can Ben 2 stop them before it's too late?

translations.value: The Mini Demons come to Bremin High and cause havoc. Our gang catch them and keep them in their school bags, but they exert a negative influence over the gang - can Ben 2 stop them before it's too late?

episodes.name: The Search For Atridax
episodes.plot: The bags with the Atridax are missing and the gang want to use magic to find them, but Luke's under house arrest. Luke makes a trust deal with his father and the gang retrieve the bags only to have them stolen.

translations.value: The bags with the Atridax are missing and the gang want to use magic to find them, but Luke's under house arrest. Luke makes a trust deal with his father and the gang retrieve the bags only to have them stolen.

episodes.name: Birth Of The Mega Demon
episodes.plot: The gang are on the hunt for the missing talisman. They realise Kayla has it, but it's too late, she's been tricked by bad Ben and gets sucked inside the Demon egg. Will Nicco be able to get her sister out?

translations.value: The gang are on the hunt for the missing talisman. They realise Kayla has it, but it's too late, she's been tricked by bad Ben and gets sucked inside the Demon egg. Will Nicco be able to get her sister out?

episodes.name: The Battle For Bremin
episodes.plot: People are disappearing and all is not right with Nicco's sister, Kayla. Realising she has part of the Demon inside, the gang trek to the forest to fight the Demon while it's incomplete. But Luke's parents have disappeared...
